svg.title: Жим с эспандером стоя — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Fix band routing. Each of two independent elastic cords goes continuously from the rear wall eye to one hand. No connector BETWEEN the two hands. Show one taut line from each handle tracking back beside its respective arm toward rear wall anchor, far line partly occluded by body. Preserve split stance and press phases. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
